title: Decree-Law No. (30) of 2002 promulgating the Environment Protection Law (مرسوم بقانون رقم (30) لسنة 2002 بإصدار قانون حماية البيئة)
citation: Decree-Law No. 30 of 2002 promulgating the Law of the Environment Protection, Official Gazette issue 11 of 2002
evidence: Al Meezan page https://almeezan.qa/legislations/decree-law/2002/30/general (opened 2026-11-03) lists status قيد التطبيق and effective date 2003-05-03 (API field effectiveDate "2003-05-03T00:00:00"; Official Gazette: الجريدة الرسمية - العدد 11 لسنة 2002). Commencement clause in the text: "ويُعمل به بعد ستة أشهر من تاريخ نشره في الجريدة الرسمية". The page date is used; the Gazette date the page shows (2002-12-01) does not by itself give it (six months after it would be 2003-06-01).
notes: Record is the whole Decree-Law as one Al Meezan text (80 article entries on the page, the issuing articles 1 to 5 first). Al Meezan shows no amended article and no amending act for it, so there is one record. Implemented by qa-environment-exec-regulation-4-2005. The first-in-force date is the page's, not derived from the commencement clause. Stored in Arabic only (ar), from QA-ALMEEZAN-CONSOLIDATED. No government English: Al Meezan's English view of this instrument translates the title, preamble and some headings and serves the article text in Arabic, and its translation row QA-ALMEEZAN-TRANSLATION is permission requested; also looked for English in the file list of the Al Meezan page (no English-language file; Official Gazette issue PDFs and an audio zip) and on the MECC laws page (Arabic links). Text is stored as Al Meezan serves it, including its editorial markers.

title: Law No. (8) of 2008 on Consumer Protection (قانون رقم (8) لسنة 2008 بشأن حماية المستهلك)
citation: Law No. 8 of 2008, Official Gazette issue 7 of 2008, as amended by Decree-Law No. 14 of 2011 and Law No. 7 of 2018
evidence: Al Meezan page https://almeezan.qa/legislations/law/2008/8/general (opened 2026-11-03) lists status قيد التطبيق, effective date 2008-07-24 and Official Gazette issue 7 of 2008 (publish date 2008-07-24). The Law has no commencement clause beyond its last article: "على جميع الجهات المختصة، كل فيما يخصه، تنفيذ هذا القانون. وينشر في الجريدة الرسمية."; the page's effective date equals the Gazette publish date.
notes: One record: Al Meezan's current text, dated 2018-05-13, the latest effective date of an article version in it. The page lists article versions dated 2008-07-24, 2011-10-24 (Decree-Law 14 of 2011) and 2018-05-13 (Law 7 of 2018) as per-article chains and serves no whole-law version for the earlier two dates, so those are not stored. The text as served holds some superseded versions side by side: article 18 marked 'معدلة ملغاة' (amended, cancelled) and both the 2008 and 2011 versions of article 18 bis. The amending acts are not separate entries because their changes are inside this text. Umbrella for environmental claims (F6) as the dispatch brief proposed: the text does not contain the word for environment (بيئة); its hooks are art. 2 (the right to correct information on goods and services) and the advertiser provisions of the penalty chapter. Stored in Arabic only (ar), from QA-ALMEEZAN-CONSOLIDATED. title: Guidance on Corporate Sustainability Reporting for companies listed on the Main Market (how to start applying the ISSB Standards), Qatar Financial Markets Authority
citation: QFMA Guidance on Corporate Sustainability Reporting for Main Market listed companies, file dated 23 November 2025
evidence: No official page states a commencement date. The PDF (opened with curl on 2026-11-03, HTTP 200, 2129752 bytes, 80 pages) carries no date in its text; 23 November 2025 appears only in the file name on qfma.org.qa. The text says it helps companies implement the mandatory provision in the Governance Code (Board resolution dated April 7, 2025).
notes: Link only: QA-QFMA-ADOPTED is permission requested (no reuse terms on qfma.org.qa; the Guidance quotes IFRS Foundation material). Voluntary guidance; it refers to a mandatory Governance Code provision whose text was not verified here. English only on the page (the Arabic QFMA path in the URL serves the English file).
